experiment: IoT-23 real Zeek traffic through the live AegisWeave pipeline
warning: IoT-23 is a set of 2018-2019 lab captures of a few IoT devices and malware samples on one research network. These measurements do not establish performance on other networks. Temporal-block tests share hosts and capture periods with training; leave-capture-out is the stronger generalization evidence.
